fields.description: A volunteer who is on this deployment. This row is what the deployment time log's ownership rule reads: a volunteer may log time against a deployment only if they appear here, checked on the server at save, so that participation cannot be fabricated by a caller who simply names a deployment. Identity is read through the volunteer's Red Profile and is never copied onto this row.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: Where this volunteer's invitation stands. Blank is the ordinary state of a roster row a coordinator added directly, meaning nobody was asked, and it is deliberately not the same as invited. Being on the roster is what participation means either way: a declined invitation is recorded, not erased, and an unanswered one never blocks a time log, because a coordinator who lists somebody who actually served must not have that record invalidated by a missing reply.
fields.label: Response

fields.description: When this volunteer joined the deployment, if they joined after it began. Reporting only: being on the roster is what participation means, so a log is not refused for falling outside these dates.
fields.label: Joined On

fields.description: When this volunteer left the deployment, if they left before it ended. Reporting only, and deliberately not a removal: somebody who served two weeks of a month stays on the roster, because they were there and their time logs are theirs. Removing them would make their own logs unfilable.
fields.label: Left On

fields.description: When the invitation was sent. Blank on a row nobody was asked about, which is what distinguishes a coordinator's direct addition from an invitation still waiting for a reply.
fields.label: Invited On

fields.description: When the volunteer answered. Kept beside the response rather than derived from it, so a society asking how long people take to reply has a figure with a time on it.
fields.label: Responded On

fields.description: What the volunteer said when they answered, most usefully why they could not go. Written by the volunteer through their own portal and never by a coordinator, which is why it is separate from the coordinator's own notes below.
fields.label: Response Note

fields.description: What this volunteer is doing on the deployment, in the coordinator's own words. Free text on purpose: a structured vocabulary of deployment roles is a society's paperwork, and a Select typed into a JSON file would be this app inventing one. Never read by code.
fields.label: Notes
